headline: Nifty closed the week up 8.58% as *1,735 stocks fell*
subline: Frontline banks ran on Friday. Midcaps and smallcaps closed lower.
hero_text: Nifty gained 8.58% on the week. Friday's lift came from financials, while midcaps and smallcaps closed in the red.

why.title: Financials led the lift
why.desc: Banks and lenders drove the Nifty higher as ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank ran.

why.title: Foreign inflow swamped exits
why.desc: FIIs bought heavily in cash while DIIs were net sellers.

why.title: Volatility hit a range high
why.desc: India VIX closed at the top of its 21 session range.

why.title: No trigger, thin breadth
why.desc: No clear catalyst showed up. Declines beat advances 1,735 to 972.

sector_reasons.Financials: Banks and lenders led, with ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank up
sector_reasons.Realty: Flat on the day, yet up 10.17% on the week
sector_reasons.IT: Lagged as midsmall IT names slipped
sector_reasons.Media: Only red group as flows went to banks
sector_reasons.Healthcare: Pharma firmed but trailed the week's leaders

bonus_text: Private Bank carried the board. Media was the pocket that lagged.
movers_note_gainers: M&M led the Nifty. ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank each added over 3.7%.
movers_note_losers: Only 5 of 50 fell, and none by more than 0.58%.
watch_text: Monday is Nifty expiry day. Put OI peaks at 24,000, call OI at 26,000, with spot at 25,030.
lessons: Banks set the week's pace. Financials, realty and durables each outran the Nifty's own gain.
Puts outweighed calls in open interest. The 24,000 strike held the heaviest put base.
The biggest names ran hardest. The top 10 equal weight index beat the Nifty 50 equal weight.
Value beat momentum. The Value 20 index rose while the Alpha 50 index slipped.
alert_text: The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Monday, 09 November 2026.
cta_headline: A big week, thin base. *Save it for Monday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Monday, 09 November, with the weekly expiry.
next_text: Monday, 09 November opens the new week with the Nifty weekly expiry. Spot closed Friday at 25,030.35.
caption_a:
Nifty gained 8.58% this week, yet 1,735 stocks fell on Friday against 972 that rose.
Nifty closed at 25,030.35, up 2.01%. Midcap 150 and Smallcap 250 ended lower.
FIIs bought Rs 13,749.82 Cr in cash. DIIs sold Rs 5,968.7 Cr.
Watch: the Nifty weekly expiry on Monday, 09 November.
